$comment: Where a location falls in the grid, at every zoom the grid has. A cell is a Web Mercator tile address, one digit a zoom level, so a cell at a shallower zoom is a prefix of the one below it: each row here is a pyramid, and both ends are held to it. Read by the Kotlin protocol test and by the browser, which must agree with each other and with these. Generated by an independent implementation; do not edit by hand, change the arithmetic on one side and see the other fail.

onTheMapFrom.$comment: The coarsest zoom anything on the map is sent at, whatever its significance: every structure and every person from the same zoom, so they arrive together and the page fades them in together at 7.25. Significance ranks what is on the map and no longer decides how far out it is drawn (decision record 0096). Both ends are held to it.
